status: FROZEN: supersedes exp_v3.1 (kept in freeze_history/ and git). Design-intent targets and weights, pseudo-Huber capped-scale loss, run-level primary metric B_r, closed-loop checkpoint selection (mean(B_r) + 0.5*CVaR_0.90(B_r) on selection_validation rollouts; death <= 0.08, OOD excess <= 0.05, runtime guard <= 0.01, fallbacks <= 0.01), fixed_default, shared boss, collection mixtures, gates, split seeds, non-overlapping seed partitions, action-support limits and the 3-combat-room loot horizon are fixed for the principal collection (see experiment_freeze.json). exp_v3.1 datasets are never reused. Do not modify after collection starts.

fixed.name: fixed_default
fixed.provenance: Canonical static configuration: neutral multipliers 1.0 (enemies use the documented base constants ENEMY_BASE_HP=30, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=6, ENEMY_SPEED=110) and spawn_count = DDA_SPAWN_BASE = 2, the documented base spawn count. A consistent historical static configuration for the current game could not be established: the ALPHA build (14bab89) used multipliers 1.0 with spawn_count 6 but different base stats (ENEMY_BASE_HP=42, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=9), and 301bf81 used ad-hoc test values (0.4/0.3/0.25/2). Not tuned on pilot outcomes.

shared_boss.description: Deterministic boss policy shared by every experimental condition. The raw action below passes through dda_core.effective_applied_config (hp x4, dmg x1.7, speed x0.9, one boss). No enemy model is invoked in boss rooms.

bot_selection.description: With the archetype's p_take_loot the bot picks one of the 3 offers uniformly at random, otherwise it takes nothing.

balance_loss.description: term_i = w_i * 2*(sqrt(1+(d/s)^2)-1) with d the distance outside the interval and s the configured scale capped, per side, at the distance between that interval bound and the physical limit; L = sum(term_i)/sum(w_i). Chosen to remove asymmetric scale artefacts and unbounded quadratic dominance (pre-freeze audit), not to favour any controller.

primary_metric.name: run_level_ordinary_balance
primary_metric.description: Per run, over ordinary combat rooms only (no boss, no non-combat rooms): death rate = deaths / rooms; post_hp = mean post-room HP ratio (0 for a fatal room); damage_share = sum(taken) / (sum(taken) + sum(dealt)); combat_efficiency = sum(kills) / max(sum(hits), 1); duration_norm = mean per-room min(t/30 s, 1). B_r = balance loss of that vector. Controllers are ranked by mean B_r across runs (run = experimental unit), with bootstrap CIs and matched-seed paired differences. Runs without ordinary combat rooms are excluded and counted.

q_loot_gate.description: Learned loot is trained only if a reward-aware Q_loot beats its information-matched state-only twin (x+c vs x, x+c+item+prior vs x+prior) on held-out runs by a MEAN aggregate-skill gain >= min_reward_gain_rel with a positive gain on EVERY grouped split in split_seeds, and beats the naive predictor on every split.

cgan_training.description: Defaults for train_cgan.py (CLI flags override and are recorded). lambda_balance=1 let the adversarial term pull G back toward the observed action distribution during the smoke pilot.

closed_loop.description: Final checkpoint selection uses OBSERVED closed-loop bot rollouts, never Q predictions. Candidate filtering: every candidate_every_epochs epochs, an epoch that passes the room-level gates (validity, min_diversity, min_sensitivity, min_epoch) becomes a candidate; after training the top_k_candidates by room-level selection score are saved through the normal checkpoint path, reloaded through model_runtime (compatibility validation) and rolled out on the frozen validation seeds (first n_runs seeds of seed_blocks.selection_validation, enemy controller = the candidate, reward policy = reward_policy, shared boss). selection_score = mean(B_r) + cvar_coef * CVaR_alpha(B_r); lower is better. CVaR_alpha = mean of the worst ceil((1-alpha)*n) run-level B_r values. Eligible only if: room-level validity/diversity/sensitivity gates pass, every validation action is valid, observed ordinary-room death rate <= max_ordinary_death_rate, every fallback is recorded and is an OOD-guard fallback, the checkpoint reloads through model_runtime, ood_excess <= max_ood_excess, runtime_guard_rate <= max_runtime_guard_rate and fallback_rate <= max_fallback_rate. OOD decomposition (post hoc on the logged rows, never altering the rollout): for every ordinary-room state reached by the candidate, the support ratio (kNN distance / training threshold) of the candidate's generated action and of the heuristic (rule_based_dda) counterfactual action for exactly the same state; cgan_ood_rate and heuristic_same_state_ood_rate are the shares with ratio > 1, ood_excess = cgan_ood_rate - heuristic_same_state_ood_rate (not clipped), runtime_guard_rate = share of generated actions with ratio > enemy_action_support.runtime_ood_factor. The absolute cGAN OOD rate is a diagnostic, not a gate. If no candidate is eligible, selection fails and no checkpoint is produced.

calibration_rule.description: Pre-specified, controller-agnostic proposal rule: continuous targets = [q25, q75] of the POOLED pilot outcomes of all collection policies; death targets keep the design ceiling. The rule never looks at which controller performs best.

principal_collection.description: Documented collection mixtures (per-run assignment by seeded draw). learned_loot is never used during collection; it may be trained afterwards only if the predefined Q_loot gate passes on the principal data.

seed_blocks.description: Non-overlapping partitions. train_collection: data for Q/G/D and Q_loot. selection_validation: closed-loop checkpoint selection only. final_test: the final controller comparison only -- never used to train, tune, select epochs/checkpoints or change targets. smoke_test: pre-freeze smoke comparisons. used_in_pilot_smoke_evaluations: consumed by exp_v2/v3.1 smoke evaluations, never used again.
